One of your nostrils is slacking off right now 👃

It's called the nasal cycle. Blood vessels inside one side of your nose swell so it lets less air through, and every few hours the sides swap. In one study, all 33 people tested were cycling, and most of us never notice.

Scientists think it may help keep the nose from drying out, and each side may smell things a little differently. If one side stays blocked and won't clear, see a doctor.

Sources: Cleveland Clinic, PLoS ONE (Kahana-Zweig et al. 2016), Wikipedia.
